title: Genomic mapping of transformed DNA fragments
author: Oskar Johansson
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.yq2fvye
materials: Sanger sequence using the TOPO vectors internal primers.

steps.title: Set up primary PCR
steps.instruction: Prepare a 25 µL primary PCR mixture containing 5 µL 5× SuperFi Buffer, 0.8 µL dNTP‑mix (10 mM each), 3 µL Internal Primer (10 µL), 0.2 µL SuperFi polymerase, 12.5 µL water, 2.5 µL Degenerate Primer (40 µM) and 1 µL genomic DNA (100 ng/µL).

steps.title: Run primary PCR program
steps.instruction: Thermal cycler program: 1) 96 °C 5 min; 2) 98 °C 10 s; 3) 70 °C 15 s; 4) 72 °C 3 min; 5) repeat steps 2‑4 for 30 cycles; 6) 98 °C 10 s; 7) 25 °C 1 min; 8) ramp to 72 °C at 0.5 °C/s; 9) 72 °C 3 min; 10) repeat steps 6‑9 once; 11) 98 °C 10 s; 12) 70 °C 15 s; 13) 72 °C 3 min; 14) 98 °C 10 s; 15) 70 °C 15 s; 16) 72 °C 3 min; 17) 98 °C 10 s; 18) 70 °C 15 s; 19) 72 °C 3 min; 20) 98 °C 10 s; 21) 40 °C 45 s; 22) 72 °C 3 min; 23) repeat steps 11‑22 for 10 cycles; 24) 72 °C 5 min; 25) hold at 4 °C indefinitely.

steps.title: Dilute primary PCR 40‑fold
steps.instruction: Add 5 µL of the primary PCR product to 195 µL of water (final volume 200 µL) to achieve a 40× dilution.

steps.title: Set up secondary PCR
steps.instruction: Prepare a 25 µL secondary PCR mixture containing 5 µL 5× SuperFi Buffer, 0.5 µL dNTP‑mix (10 mM each), 1.5 µL Internal Primer 2 (10 µM), 0.2 µL SuperFi polymerase, 1.5 µL Specific Primer 1 (10 µM), 15.3 µL water, and 1 µL of the 40× diluted primary PCR product.

steps.title: Run secondary PCR program
steps.instruction: Thermal cycler program: 1) 98 °C 30 s; 2) 98 °C 10 s; 3) 70 °C 15 s; 4) 72 °C 3 min; 5) 98 °C 10 s; 6) 70 °C 15 s; 7) 72 °C 3 min; 8) 98 °C 10 s; 9) 57 °C 30 s; 10) 72 °C 3 min; 11) repeat steps 2‑10 for 12 cycles; 12) 72 °C 5 min; 13) hold at 4 °C indefinitely.

steps.title: Dilute secondary PCR 40‑fold
steps.instruction: Add 5 µL of the secondary PCR product to 195 µL of water (final volume 200 µL) to achieve a 40× dilution.

steps.title: Set up tertiary PCR
steps.instruction: Prepare a 50 µL tertiary PCR mixture containing 10 µL 5× SuperFi Buffer, 0.8 µL dNTP‑mix (10 mM each), 2 µL Internal Primer 3 (10 µM), 0.3 µL SuperFi polymerase, 2 µL Specific Primer 2 (10 µM), 25.4 µL water, and 2 µL of the 40× diluted secondary PCR product.

steps.title: Run tertiary PCR program
steps.instruction: Thermal cycler program: 1) 98 °C 30 s; 2) 98 °C 10 s; 3) 57 °C 30 s; 4) 72 °C 3 min; 5) repeat steps 2‑4 for 14 cycles; 6) 72 °C 5 min; 7) hold at 4 °C indefinitely.

steps.title: Gel electrophoresis and cleanup
steps.instruction: Run the tertiary PCR products on a 1 % agarose gel, excise the desired bands, and purify the DNA using a gel‑cleanup kit (e.g., Promega Wizard).

steps.title: Clone purified fragments into TOPO vector
steps.instruction: Ligate 2 µL of the purified DNA into a Blunt TOPO vector (Thermo Fisher Scientific), transform competent E. coli DH5α (Thermo Fisher Scientific) by a 30 s heat shock at 42 °C, plate, pick colonies, grow 5 mL overnight cultures, and extract the plasmid vectors.
